source: VIP_2A03.ori diagnostic-code catalog at ROM 1222 (3 bytes per internal id: BCD generic-code word + MIL flash byte), named from the 1997 Dodge Viper service manual trouble-code chart pp. 25-3..25-7 (PDF 926-930); monitor tables 70E2/712D used for enablement notes
notes: Command 10 sends the list as stored (observed newest first), stops at the first 00, then sends FE and a checksum.
MIL flash codes 12 (battery disconnected within the last 50 key-on cycles) and 55 (end of code display) come from the blink serializer and have no internal id.
Ids 00, BF, CE, CF, DD-DF and E1-E9 have an all-zero catalog record and ids F0-FF lie past the catalog end (14F2); they are omitted.
'Right Rear (or just)' is the manual's wording for the right-bank sensor; 'Left Front' is the left bank.
ENABLED / disabled in the evidence field refers to bit 01 of the monitor's configuration byte in this image; ids with no monitor-table entry may still be set by other code or by the coprocessor.
